hints.title: Running Window Sum
hints.text: Maintain the sum of calories for the continuous k-day span as the window slides across the schedule.

hints.title: Score Adjustments
hints.text: Compare each k-day sum to the lower and upper bounds: add 1 point if sum > upper, subtract 1 point if sum < lower.

hints.title: Constant Shift Transitions
hints.text: Add incoming day calories[i] and subtract departing day calories[i - k] to maintain the sum in constant time per step.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing the sum of k elements at every day takes O(N * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A sliding sum maintains the current window total with O(1) updates per day.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement a clean fixed-window prefix subtraction.
complexity.notes: Initial window consists of the first k days.
